instruction: Read in/settings.env (KEY=VALUE lines; a repeated key: last wins) and in/schema.json. Add every key from schema.defaults that is not already set. Write all keys as KEY=VALUE lines sorted by key to out/settings.resolved.env. Then write out/check.txt: the required keys still missing, one per line in schema order, or the single line OK if none are missing.
note: All paths are relative to the workspace root.
